content.text:
Opened all 47 pages successfully. Below is the first listed notable change or highlighted change on each page.

- **v22.0.0** — Dropped support for ESM import assertions. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.0.0))
- **v22.1.0** — Added `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` for automatic on-disk code caching. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.1.0))
- **v22.2.0** — Added `--disable-wasm-trap-handler` to allow WebAssembly execution with limited virtual memory. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.2.0))
- **v22.3.0** — Made `--run` traverse parent folders. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.3.0))
- **v22.4.0** — Added an experimental Web Storage API. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.4.0))
- **v22.5.0** — Exposed WebSockets through the HTTP module. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.5.0))
- **v22.6.0** — Added experimental TypeScript type stripping via `--experimental-strip-types`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.6.0))
- **v22.7.0** — Added `--experimental-transform-types` to transform TypeScript-only syntax into JavaScript. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.7.0))
- **v22.8.0** — Added `module.enableCompileCache()` to enable on-disk module code caching programmatically. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.8.0))
- **v22.9.0** — Added `util.getCallSite()` to retrieve the current execution stack trace. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.9.0))
- **v22.10.0** — Introduced the `"module-sync"` exports condition. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.10.0))
- **v22.11.0** — Transitioned Node.js 22.x to LTS under the codename “Jod”; otherwise only metadata changed. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.11.0))
- **v22.12.0** — Enabled `require(esm)` by default. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.12.0))
- **v22.13.0** — Stabilized the Permission Model. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.13.0))
- **v22.14.0** — Updated root certificates to NSS 3.107. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.14.0))
- **v22.15.0** — Implemented partial error comparison in assertions. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.15.0))
- **v22.16.0** — Updated timezone data to 2025b. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.16.0))
- **v22.17.0** — Deprecated constructing `node:http` classes without `new`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.17.0))
- **v22.18.0** — Enabled TypeScript type stripping by default. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.18.0))
- **v22.19.0** — Added `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA=1`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.19.0))
- **v22.20.0** — Updated bundled OpenSSL to 3.5.2. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.20.0))
- **v22.21.0** — Added `--use-env-proxy`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.21.0))
- **v24.0.0** — Updated V8 to 13.6. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.0.0))
- **v24.1.0** — Added JonasBa (Jonas Badalic) to collaborators. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.1.0))
- **v24.2.0** — Removed HTTP/2 priority signaling support. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.2.0))
- **v24.3.0** — Added islandryu (Shima Ryuhei) to collaborators. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.3.0))
- **v24.4.0** — Added `outputLength` support to `crypto.hash()` for XOF functions. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.4.0))
- **v24.5.0** — Upgraded bundled OpenSSL to 3.5.1. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.5.0))
- **v24.6.0** — Added `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA=1`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.6.0))
- **v24.7.0** — Highlighted post-quantum cryptography support in `node:crypto`, including ML-KEM and ML-DSA. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.7.0))
- **v24.8.0** — Added HTTP/2 network inspection in Chrome DevTools. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.8.0))
- **v24.9.0** — Added `shouldUpgradeCallback` so HTTP servers can control upgrades. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.9.0))
- **v24.10.0** — Allowed per-stream `inspectOptions` for the console. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.10.0))
- **v24.11.0** — Transitioned Node.js 24.x to LTS under the codename “Krypton”; otherwise only metadata changed. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.11.0))
- **v26.0.0** — Enabled the Temporal API by default. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.0.0))
- **v26.1.0** — Added experimental `node:ffi` for loading dynamic libraries and calling native symbols. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.1.0))
- **v26.2.0** — Marked `stream.compose` stable. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.2.0))
- **v26.3.0** — Warned that macOS universal binaries might not remain available throughout Node.js 26’s lifetime. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.3.0))
- **v26.4.0** — Updated `blockList` stability status to release candidate. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.4.0))
- **v26.5.0** — Announced a new release-signing key for Stewart X Addison. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.5.0))
- **v26.6.0** — Added MikeMcC399 (Mike McCready) as a collaborator. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.6.0))
- **v26.7.0** — Added support for loading private keys through STORE loaders. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.7.0))
- **v26.8.0** — Added `--analyze` mode to benchmark `compare.js`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.8.0))
- **v26.9.0** — Added a generic MAC API to `crypto`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.9.0))
- **v26.10.0** — Added `crypto.parsePKCS12()`. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.10.0))
- **v26.11.0** — Added `isLatin1` to the buffer module. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.11.0))
- **v26.12.0** — Added throwing behavior when WebAssembly or RX support is missing. ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.12.0))
